inputs.text: Exactly—the handouts are the cover story. Bigger monthly aid for women, Rs 8,000 household coupons, free pumpsets for farmers and promises to fishermen are meant to make people feel cared for, while the real decisions about FDI, jobs and AI stay out of public view. The talk of progress is there to make the arrangement look inevitable; the benefits buy goodwill while the people who stand to profit from investment and technology remain conveniently unnamed.
